comentarios: Visit to Puerto Inírida with Pablo Florez, Guilherme Brito and John Lobel to study this Thamnophilus, discovered at Inírida by PF in August 2016, and here provisionally assigned to T. palliatus, in recognition of its apparently closer morphological similarity to the latter, rather than to T. tenuepunctatus. This is one of a series of recordings of a pair, the closest that we found to the town of Puerto Inírida, and quite possibly the same birds (certainly in the same territory) as depicted in the figures in Florez, P. (2017) A mysterious antshrike in eastern Colombia. Neotrop. Birding 20: 21-24. This territory comprises second-growth forest along a narrow caño and bordering a cleared area.
